scope: Sidebar rows show a trailing spinner while a run is in flight and a blue dot when a background run finishes unseen, yielding to the more button on hover with constant row height. New conversations appear as a skeleton placeholder and receive their title asynchronously, generated at submit from the user message. The collapsed recent-chats rail button and the mobile history button show a badge while anything is unread.
exceptions: The placeholder row appears after the submit API returns (~0.5s), not optimistically on click.
Unread state is in memory only and does not survive a page reload.
